programme.title: Love In Translation
programme.desc: (2021) Romantic comedy starring Michelle Argyris. A linguistics student is approached by a charming museum curator for some French classes, but will she find herself fluent in the language of love?

programme.title: Two For The Win
programme.desc: A world champion ski racer prepares for the biggest race of his life all whilst falling for a local ski instructor. Starring Trevor Donovan (2021)

programme.title: Love, Game, Match
programme.desc: (2021) Romance with Cristine Prosperi and Dale Moss. New-in-town teacher Liz agrees to help test her students' matchmaking website - so will it be singles or doubles when she meets tennis coach Ted?

programme.title: Matching Hearts
programme.desc: (2020) Romance starring Taylor Cole. A professional matchmaker is tasked with matchmaking a perpetually single man to boost her company's profile. Could the perfect match be right in front of them?

programme.title: Love On Repeat
programme.desc: When Amber starts re-living the same day over and over again, she realizes she is stuck in limbo and must finally decide what it will take to make her truly happy. Starring Jen Lilley (2019)

programme.title: Law Of Attraction
programme.desc: Allison Williams, a young female attorney, tries to impress her law firm partners in an attempt to make partner with her first big case.

programme.title: Sweet Home Carolina
programme.desc: (2017) Romantic comedy starring Heather McComb. A stressed-out single mum moves to South Carolina to claim an inherited house, where unexpected love and Southern charm await.

programme.title: When Love Came to Town
programme.desc: Abby is a famous author whose latest stop on her book tour takes her to the town of Bliss. But little does she know that the locals are keen to play matchmaker for her. Lauren Holly stars. (2014)

programme.title: Love's Last Resort
programme.desc: A woman leaves her immature boyfriend, hoping he will grow up and beg her to come back. However, six months later, she finds out that he's engaged to someone else.

programme.title: Let Love Grow
programme.desc: (2022) Romance starring Jennifer Bonner. Landscape architect Evie is a hit with stubborn new client Ryan's daughters - leading her to realise she's the subject of Operation Grow a Girlfriend!

programme.title: Baking up Love
programme.desc: A confectionery store owner Lynn is convinced by the people of her town to enter the Great Pumpkin Bake Off. With the arrival of her unruly niece Julie, has she beaten of more than she can chew? (2021

programme.title: Baked With A Kiss
programme.desc: (2022) Culinary romance starring Jonathan Stoddard and Ansley Gordon. Renowned for her magical True Love pie, a baker accidentally serves one to a rude customer, who ends up falling in love with her.

programme.title: Two Chefs and A Wedding Cake
programme.desc: (2022) Foodie fun romance. Sparks fly for a food critic at her sister's wedding when she clashes with a chef infamous for banning reviewers from his restaurant. Can they turn rivalry into romance?

programme.title: The Way To The Heart
programme.desc: (2022) Romance with Meghan Heffern. When a big-city chef loses her spark, her boss insists she takes a break to find herself again. Will a visit to her hometown help her rediscover her passions?

programme.title: A Royal Recipe for Love
programme.desc: (2023) Flavourful romance starring Laura Miyata and David Lafontaine. An NYC baker would love to land a cookbook deal. Will a dash of royalty and a spoonful of romance help fulfil her dream?

programme.title: Love, Romance and Chocolate
programme.desc: Emma and chocolatier Luc compete for Belgium's Royal Chocolatier. The beauty and romance of Bruges inspire unique chocolate combinations, but will their entry win without them losing their hearts?

programme.title: With Love, Your Sweetly Salted
programme.desc: (2023) Anonymous food critic Alison goes undercover as a prep cook to make amends with the chef she accidentally trashed online, but things soon begin to heat up in the kitchen.

programme.title: The Royal Bake Off
programme.desc: (2023) Showstopper romance with Ansley Gordon and Christian Howard. There's no room for soggy bottoms as two rivals compete to bake a cake fit for a King. But who will be crowned royal star baker?
